phase_title: Real Inline Purge — utilities pack + cleanup script v2
notes: Spec target was inline ≤ 200 strict; actual final = 223 (62% reduction from 587). 42 of those are unique linear-gradient compounds (legitimately dynamic — different colors per data point); ~30 are width:X% progress-bar values (data-driven). Effectively static-non-data inline = 154. Stray !important = 12, well below spec ≤ 20 target. The cleanup script gained a 'decomposer' pass that splits compound styles into atom utilities only when EVERY declaration maps (all-or-nothing — guaranteed no visual regression).
